relations.subject: sdk:cloud-connection-troubleshooting
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - promoted predicate for an ordering/sequencing precondition among documented steps
relations.evidence: Before carrying out other troubleshooting, please check that your application code is configured for TLS/SSL, using the default method of connecting (not http/https), and not specifying any port numbers.

relations.subject: sdk:cluster-connection-lifecycle
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - promoted predicate for a component observed through a named metric/endpoint/log surface
relations.evidence: If you appear to be having connectivity issues, it'd be good to diagnostically check for lower level details with [SDK doctor](https://github.com/couchbaselabs/sdk-doctor).

relations.subject: sdk:sdk-doctor
relations.object: a stable cluster (no active rebalancing) for accurate diagnostic output
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - promoted predicate for a capability the underlying environment must have for the subject to be usable/reliable
relations.evidence:
Diagnostics can only provide accurate results when your cluster
 is in a stable state.  Active rebalancing and other cluster configuration
 changes can cause the output of the doctor to be inconsistent or in the
 worst cases, completely incorrect.

relations.subject: sdk:dns-srv-bootstrap
relations.object: large DNS SRV responses on some older/caching DNS resolvers
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - promoted predicate for a stated, bounded non-support boundary
relations.evidence: Occasionally, some DNS providers can run into issues with large DNS SRV records. This can manifest as a host not found issue.

relations.subject: sdk:dns-srv-bootstrap
relations.object: a DNS provider/resolver that supports modern, large DNS SRV records
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - promoted predicate for a capability the underlying environment must have for the subject to be usable
relations.evidence: As a workaround, you can switch to a DNS provider which can support modern DNS SRV records.

relations.subject: sdk:cloud-connection-troubleshooting
relations.object: trusting the Security Certificate used by a TLS-intercepting proxy, when connecting through one
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - promoted predicate for a capability the underlying environment must have for the subject to be usable
relations.evidence: That if you are connecting via a proxy that intercepts TLS connections, you have configured the SDK to trust the Security Certificate used by the proxy. This is a common issue when connecting from inside a corporate network.

notable_absence.finding: This page covers DNS-SRV troubleshooting in depth (the same mechanism managing-connections.md documents) and cluster/bootstrap diagnosis (the same territory health-check.md's ping/diagnostics cover), but contains no internal markdown links back to either page - both cross-references, if they exist, run only in the other direction (managing-connections.md links forward to this page).

cross_product_finding: The page's own recommended diagnostic workflow routes entirely through non-Couchbase-core tooling: comparing `nslookup` results 'from a shell from your default DNS server to a public DNS server, like those from Google or Cloudflare', and running `sdk-doctor`, a couchbaselabs (community/labs, not core product) GitHub tool, rather than any Capella-branded or core-SDK-bundled diagnostic.
